brief.headline: Close the 13.6% price gap to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG — we're paying ₹14.26 L/yr more than we need to

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP to match our best-in-system price
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Sayaji Industries Limited ₹66.48/KG for the same material; our current ₹75.51/KG with Universal Starch creates a 13.6% gap and ₹14.26 L annual excess spend. The India export unit value for dextrose sits at 42.95 ₹/kg, confirming significant room below our current rate.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Maintain 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹4.90 L working capital already committed at 30 days; no incremental ask

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch is a ₹514.62 Cr revenue company with 3.7% net margin and 7.4% EBITDA margin, growing at 21.4%/yr. Their 0.73x debt-to-equity is manageable and they carry a C health score (51/100) with no red flags. We represent only 0.12% of their revenue at ₹59.65 L — minimal leverage as a standalone customer. However, their fast growth means they value volume commitments, and their margins leave room to move on price. Push firmly on the price gap but frame it as a path to higher volume from us.

evidence.point: We pay 13.6% above our best dextrose price

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji. Revenue ₹2359.06 Cr, health score C (56/100).

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose) — growing capacity. Revenue ₹821.13 Cr, health score B (63/100).

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited
alternates.why: Already our best-price supplier at ₹66.48/KG — proven quality and reliability for Dextrose Anhydrous IP.

risks: At 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr revenue, we lack solo clout — they may walk if pushed without a volume sweetener.
Their 21.4%/yr growth suggests strong demand elsewhere; don't assume they need our ₹59.65 L badly.
C health score (51/100) and 3.7% net margin mean thin cushion — verify supply continuity even if price holds.
India export benchmark of 42.95 ₹/kg implies commodity pressure, but pharma-grade premiums may justify part of the gap — qualify spec differences before demanding full parity.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're carrying a 13.6% price premium versus Sayaji at ₹66.48/KG — help us understand how we close that ₹14.26 L gap and grow volume together.
